offer.text: The child clings on, weak but breathing. There's still hope — gather 6 sweet berries and a honey bottle for a tonic, and we may pull them back yet. Take whatever time you need; just don't fail them twice.

accept.text: Thank you. Bring what you can; I'll keep watch over them.

decline.text: I understand. The guilt is a heavy thing to carry.

in_progress.text: How goes the gathering? The tonic can wait a little longer.

ready.text: Everything I need — let me prepare it at once.

complete.text: The colour's back in their cheeks. You set right what went wrong, and that takes more strength than never falling at all.
